question: I need you to look into the actor collaborations and tell me how many actors have made more films with Yash Chopra than with any other director. This will help us understand his influence on the industry better.
sql:
WITH yash_films AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT mc.MID 
    FROM M_Cast mc
    JOIN M_Director md ON mc.MID = md.MID
    WHERE md.PID = 'nm0007181'
),
actor_yash_counts AS (
    SELECT LTRIM(mc.PID) as PID, COUNT(DISTINCT mc.MID) as yash_count
    FROM M_Cast mc
    JOIN yash_films yf ON mc.MID = yf.MID
    GROUP BY LTRIM(mc.PID)
),
actor_other_counts AS (
    SELECT LTRIM(mc.PID) as PID, md.PID as director_pid, COUNT(DISTINCT mc.MID) as director_count
    FROM M_Cast mc
    JOIN M_Director md ON mc.MID = md.MID
    WHERE md.PID != 'nm0007181'
    GROUP BY LTRIM(mc.PID), md.PID
),
max_other AS (
    SELECT PID, MAX(director_count) as max_other_count
    FROM actor_other_counts
    GROUP BY PID
)
SELECT COUNT(*) as actor_count
FROM actor_yash_counts ayc
LEFT JOIN max_other mo ON ayc.PID = mo.PID
WHERE ayc.yash_count > COALESCE(mo.max_other_count, 0)
